entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Estonian Museum of Applied Art and Design is a museum dedicated to the history of applied arts and design in Estonia. Located in Tallinn, the museum was established in 1971, and opened in 1980 as part of the Estonian National Art Museum branch. It became independent in 2004.
